products.title: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven with Easy View Windows, Sync Finish, Hi-Fry, Auto Shutoff, 2 Independent 3Qt Nonstick Dishwasher Safe Frying Baskets, Digital Double Air Fryer - Black
products.blurb: Two 3-quart baskets that cook and finish together, each with its own window so you can watch both. The dual-basket shape for people who cook two things at once.

listing_notes.note: The listing's own details table gives Capacity: 6 liters, while the title and the bullet copy say 6-quart / two 3-quart baskets. The quart figure is the one the product name and the two-basket claim use, so that is what this site records. Units disagree on the source page.

faq: Is this a dual-basket air fryer?

Yes. The listing's title names two independent 3-quart baskets, and its bullet copy describes a combined 6-quart capacity with a Sync Finish so the baskets can finish together. That is the feature that separates it from the single-basket 8-quart in the same shop.
How hot does it get?

The listing's bullet copy states a digital temperature range of 200-450F, and the title names a Hi-Fry setting. Note that the same page's details table gives the capacity as '6 liters' while the title says 6 quart - the two units disagree on one page (FLG-018).
What should I measure before buying?
The listed footprint is 13.38"D x 11.81"W x 10.63"H and the listed weight is 13.3 lb. Measure the depth of your counter and the clearance above the unit, not just the square footage you have free.

products.title: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven | Countertop Convection Cooker, 24 One-Touch Preset Options, Extra Large Interior, Six Cooking Accessories Included
products.blurb: A French-door, oven-style cavity with convection and a long row of one-touch presets — built around big cooks, whole-bird roasts and 12-inch pizzas rather than a single basket.
products.title_prior_capture: Emeril Lagasse Extra Large French Door Air Fryer Toaster Oven Combo, 24 Cooking Functions and Digital Controls, 7 Accessories Included, Stainless Steel Finish, 26QT Capacity
products.title_prior_capture_note: Earlier capture of the same listing read '7 Accessories Included'. The live <title> element read on 2026-11-20 says 'Six Cooking Accessories Included'. Both strings are kept; neither is silently dropped. See FLG-010.

listing_notes.note: Accessory count: the page title says 'Six Cooking Accessories Included'; the bullet copy in the same read said '7 Accessories Included'. This site does not pick one — it links the listing and states both.

Preset count: the page title says '24 One-Touch Preset Options'; the bullet list on the same page says '25 COOKING PRE-SETS' and then names eleven modes (ribs, defrost, bake, toast, chicken, pizza, pastry, slow cook, roast, reheat, keep warm). Neither number is used as a headline on this site.

Serving claim: the bullet copy says the 26-quart cavity is 'suitable for preparing food for 4–6 people', can rotisserie a 6-lb chicken and bake a 12" pizza. That is the manufacturer's own sizing claim on the listing, quoted as such.

faq: Is it an air fryer or an oven?

The listing describes both: a 26-quart French-door air fryer toaster oven whose bullets name cooking modes including toast, ribs, slow cook and roast. Its details table lists 16.9"D x 15.8"W x 14.8"H and a capacity of 24.6 liters.
How many presets and accessories does it come with?

The listing disagrees with itself. The page title says 24 one-touch preset options and six cooking accessories, while the bullet heading says 25 cooking pre-sets, and an earlier capture of the same page read 7 accessories. Both readings are published on the Flagged for review page; this site picks neither (FLG-010, FLG-020).
How large a cook can it handle?

The listing's own bullet says the 26-quart cavity is sized for 4-6 people, can rotisserie a 6-lb chicken and bake a 12-inch pizza. That is the seller's sizing claim on the listing, quoted as a claim and not as advice from this desk (FLG-021).

faq: Which size will I actually get?

How much power does it draw?

The page title says '450F Hi-Fry Option' while the bullet copy on the same page says a temperature range from 200-400F. Both strings are shown on the specs table rather than one of them being quietly chosen (FLG-005).

listing_notes.note: Model number: the US listing's product-details table did not show it in the 2026-11-20 read. The 'HT07' string seen on an Amazon.fr listing is not carried over to this page, so the cell stays blank (FLG-015) and the canonical-ASIN question stays open (FLG-004).

faq: What accuracy is claimed?

The listing states a tolerance of +/-0.5F, names NIST and NSF certification, and describes an auto-rotating LED screen and IP67 waterproofing. Those are the listing's claims; nobody on this desk has tested the device, so no measured figure appears anywhere on this site.
What is the model number?

It is not shown on the US listing's product-details table in the read of 2026-11-20. An 'HT07' model string appears on the brand's French listing, which is why the specs table marks the model unconfirmed for the US page instead of asserting it (FLG-004).
Does it work in an air fryer?

It is an instant-read device: you put the tip in the food for a second and read the number off the device. For a probe that stays in the food while it cooks, the other thermometer in this shop is the one whose listing names air-fryer use.
products.model_note: Blank: HT07 appeared only on an Amazon.fr listing, not the US listing observed (FLG-015)

products.short_label: CHEF iQ Sense Gen3 (3 probes, WiFi)
products.blurb: Three thin probes and a WiFi hub that report to your phone, so the probes can stay in the food while you keep an eye on the cook from another room.
products.title_prior_capture: CHEF iQ Sense [2025 Model] | Smart Wireless Meat Thermometer | 3 Ultra-Thin Probes | WiFi Unlimited Range | 1000°F Heat Safe | 5 Sensors | BBQ, Grill, Oven, Smoker, Air Fryer | Gen3
products.title_prior_capture_note: Same product; the '[2025 Model]' tag appeared in the earlier capture and is absent from the live title read on 2026-11-20. Marketing-string drift only — no spec changes.
faq: How many probes come with it?
The listing names 3 ultra-thin probes and a hub with 5 sensors, reporting over WiFi, with probes stated heat safe to 1000F. It also lists BBQ, grill, oven, smoker and air fryer among its uses.
Does it need an app?

The headline feature on the listing is WiFi reporting, so the reading arrives on a phone - which means the app, the hub and the router are part of the product. If you would rather not install an app, the instant-read in this shop is the other shape.
What does 'unlimited range' mean?

It is a marketing phrase on the listing. What it means is that the hub reports over your network rather than over a short radio link; how far the hub can sit from the cooker is a question about your router and your house, not a published number.
